human_economic_burden.boundary: Reported service disruption events, not people or service-hours lost; includes pandemic-period disruptions.

extent.boundary: Reporting coverage only; unreported countries are missing, not zero.

source_locators: UNDRR Sendai midterm review Target D: average 142,852 critical infrastructure units and facilities destroyed or damaged per year between 2015 and 2021.
UNDRR Sendai midterm review Target D: over 363,184 basic-service disruptions in 44 reporting countries during 2020 and 2021.
UNDRR resilient infrastructure focus: modeled global annual infrastructure losses exceed US$700 billion (context only).
excluded_from_scoring: physical-damage attribution for all pandemic-period disruptions

transformations.formula: Normalize the source-reported annual-average damaged-or-destroyed critical-infrastructure unit count; do not multiply by seven without annual records.
Normalize the lower-bound two-year service-disruption count without converting events to people, duration or physical damage.
Divide reporting countries by the UN Member State denominator; leave unreported countries missing.

receipts.uncertainty: Country reporting is incomplete and definitions of facility, damage and service disruption differ. The 2020-2021 service total includes pandemic-related disruptions and cannot be attributed only to physical asset damage. Global annual infrastructure loss is modeled.
receipts.freshness: UNDRR Sendai midterm Target D assessment, 2023; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T18:31:20.931Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNDRR quantifies recurring critical-infrastructure damage, basic-service disruptions, a seven-year observation window and an explicit reporting-country denominator.
higher_priority_failures: The operational US DOE OE-417 snapshot is a national electricity-disturbance feed and cannot supply a current global multi-infrastructure aggregation.
